name: ogenic-phase-vi
description: One OGENIC toolkit for routing, building, migrating, deploying, verifying and resuming work across connected providers with Cloudflare as the primary runtime.

interface.shortDescription: One-click resume control plane for all OGENIC work.
interface.longDescription: Routes one user-facing toolkit across GitHub, Google Drive, Linear, Documents, Template Creator, Cloudflare and Infisical. Selecting the tool boots from the compact LIVE_STATE checkpoint, verifies live GitHub/Cloudflare/D1 state, and resumes the first unfinished Phase VI task without replaying old chat history.
interface.defaultPrompt: Activate OGENIC Phase VI in /OG.resume mode. Read skills/ogenic-phase-vi/LIVE_STATE.md first, verify the current GitHub branch/HEAD and CI/deploy state, check Cloudflare health and D1 shared state when authorized, then continue the first unfinished task. Do not ask the user to restate old chat context and do not replay the full conversation history. After a verified milestone or blocker, persist a compact checkpoint back to LIVE_STATE.md.
